statuses.implemented: Works and is wired to the runtime in this release.
statuses.platform-limited: Works only on some platforms; see platforms/notes.
statuses.planned: Not implemented yet (planned for a later phase). Cannot be enabled.

fileUpload.label: File Upload (<input type=file>, multiple, capture)
fileUpload.notes: Provided by the OS WebView; on Android by wry's file chooser (multiple files, MIME filters, camera capture).

camera.label: Camera (getUserMedia video)
camera.notes: Policy-gated by origin. Linux: denied (no native consent prompt yet). iOS: needs a signed build; OS prompt.

geolocation.label: Geolocation
geolocation.notes: Linux: denied. macOS/iOS: handled by the OS prompt, not by the origin policy.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.notes: Desktop: saved to the Downloads folder (no progress UI). Android: system DownloadManager (background, notification). blob:/data: URLs on Android are unsupported. iOS: not supported in this release.

notifications.label: Native Notifications (via bridge + Notification API shim)
notifications.notes: Local notifications only. Push (FCM/APNs) is not part of this release.

clipboard.label: Clipboard write (bridge)
clipboard.notes: Write only. Reading the clipboard from web content is deliberately not exposed.

externalApps.label: Open out-of-scope links / tel: mailto: sms: in system apps

networkMonitoring.label: Network monitoring, offline page, auto-retry, crash/hang recovery
networkMonitoring.notes: TCP/DNS reachability probe + page heartbeat watchdog (heuristic, not a native crash callback).

multipleWindows.label: Multiple windows (window.open popups)
multipleWindows.notes: Desktop only; Android/iOS do not expose popup creation in Tauri.

paymentHandoff.label: Payment/app handoff via custom URL schemes
paymentHandoff.notes: Only schemes listed in security.paymentSchemes. Android intent: URLs are intentionally blocked.

backgroundDownloads.label: Background downloads
backgroundDownloads.notes: Automatic with downloads on Android (DownloadManager). Not available on desktop.

systemBars.label: Status/navigation bar colors
systemBars.notes: Always applied from appearance.statusBarColor/navigationBarColor on Android < 15 only (Android 15+ enforces edge-to-edge). Not implemented on iOS/desktop.

hapticFeedback.label: Haptic feedback
hapticFeedback.notes: Planned (phase 2). navigator.vibrate works natively on Android WebView only.

pullToRefresh.label: Pull to refresh
pullToRefresh.notes: Planned (phase 2): needs a native SwipeRefresh/UIRefreshControl integration.
